details:
1. Switch between avatars with VRCFT tracking and native one (where is just eyes setted-up trough descriptor)

2. Check if other people don't update your avatar by hide/unhide it.

This is depends on many things, but when people don't update your avatar, or you didn't reset it for them, sometimes avatars what use Eye Tracking by allow it control descriptor setted eyes, it just appears freezed for other players.

Provided steps is not 100% works every time, you just need couple of person to check it, and switch between avis with VRCFT setup and working eyes trough descriptor. Maybe also avatars without eye settings in descriptor can cause the bug, but it was not visible locally, it's other players just see your glaze freeze in place and eyelid static as well, until they hide/unhide you, or you press Reset Avatar.

Bug exist since native eye tracking was added up to this actual version.
title: Native Eye Tracking don't update after switching avatars
